methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $60M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
REGENT Craft is a Series A-stage transportation company founded by Billy Thalheimer and Mike Klinker that has raised $60M to date. The broader transportation sector includes six private peers (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, FleetZero, Beyond Aero) and no public comparables, though meaningful same-stage and adjacent-stage peers within transportation remain limited.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method. Stage-progression analysis uses the $60M total raised as a proxy for current implied value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $120M. The peer-median approach is not applicable here: while three transportation companies exist in the broader dataset, none met the filtering criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier classification, which would have required at least three datapoints to be reliable. Using an all-sector median would introduce undue noise given the frontier-tech transportation context.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $102M (low) to $138M (median), with $120M as the point estimate. This range reflects moderate downside and upside scenarios around the stage-progression anchor, but the analysis carries material uncertainty. The primary limitation is the absence of tight peer comparables; any revision would benefit from either closer same-stage transportation peers or clearer public market comp multiples. Management execution risk and technical milestone achievement remain unmeasured in this quantitative framework.
